subject.title: [Bug] v2026.5.22 启动后 Gateway CPU 持续 100%+，导致请求延迟飙升 50-100 倍

question: Should normal gateway startup stop running provider-auth warm sweeps by default and keep eager startup warming only as an explicit opt-in?
rationale: The source-backed fix shape is clear, but changing eager provider-auth preparation affects upgrade behavior and auth-provider latency tradeoffs that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Accept Default-Off Startup Warm
options.body: Refresh the open candidate PR and land it after preserving explicit opt-in startup warming plus auth-failure rewarm behavior.

options.title: Require Upgrade Auth Proof First
options.body: Ask for fresh-install and upgrade proof showing setups that relied on eager prepared auth state still behave acceptably or have a clear opt-in path.

options.title: Keep Eager Startup Warm
options.body: Reject the default-off approach and track a different mitigation for CPU/event-loop pressure without changing startup auth preparation.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Off Startup Warm
recommendation.body: Refresh the open candidate PR and land it after preserving explicit opt-in startup warming plus auth-failure rewarm behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the active maintainer-labeled PR for the default-off startup behavior and recent release-adjacent history in the same surface.
